title: vsp CLI & Profile Composition Redesign (Phases 0-3)
description: Consolidate artagon-vscode-profiles into a single installable Rust CLI (vsp) backed by single-file packs/*.jsonc, presets.jsonc, catalog/{extensions,policy}.jsonc, tiered per-platform vsp.lock.json, and fork-free ~/.config/vsp/config.jsonc across 4 gated phases: Phase 0 (v2.0.1 Bash security hotfix), Phase 1 (v2.1.0 ADR + thin bin/vsp + Rust read-only planner), Phase 2 (v2.2.0 schema consolidation + Rust mutating sync + untrack 83 generated files), Phase 3 (v3.0.0 full Rust cutover + user config + Formula/vsp.rb + docs). Decisions locked: D1 JSONC-only user config; D2 exit 7 for incomplete observation; D3 fail-closed disable contested stale-lock reclaim in v2.0.1; D4 Homebrew formula ready with Rust binary; D5 preserve ai chat.editor.fontSize=14 override for byte parity.

description: Fix H1/N1 (scripts/lib/catalog.sh:152-160 nested JSON path + case-insensitive exec override + string boolean normalization), H3 (scripts/validate-json.sh:234 & scripts/lib/vsix-pin.sh:84-90 fail-closed missing extension-pins.json with explicit warned install bypass; propagate mv at :242 and digest return in common.sh:30), H5 (scripts/lib/common.sh:491-493 spaced macOS VS Code path + failed ps scan = busy; fail-closed disable contested stale-lock reclamation at :435). Add BATS regressions in scripts/tests/bats/validate-security.bats.

close_reason: Merged af90f307 (hotfix-security): H1/N1, H3, H5 fixed + 134/134 BATS + shellcheck + invariance passed

title: Phase 2.3 (v2.2.0): Migrate consumers, untrack 83 generated files & update CI/hooks
description: Move remaining internal consumers of _merged/ and exports/ to vsp in-memory compilation; remove 83 generated tracked paths (_merged/, profiles/*/{extensions,settings}.json, exports/) via git rm --cached and update .gitignore; delete superseded old modules/ and profiles/ directories once new packs/ + presets.jsonc own canonical truth; update .github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit to run Rust build/test/clippy/rustdoc, reproducible vsp dev dist determinism, ShellCheck/Zsh/Fish on remaining scripts, and BATS on clean checkout.
acceptance_criteria: 0 generated files tracked in git; clean checkout passes cargo test/clippy/doc, vsp dev validate, vsp dev dist determinism, shellcheck/zsh/fish, and full test suite.

title: Phase 3.1 (v3.0.0): Personal ~/.config/vsp/config.jsonc, vsp init/self, vspcli compat mode & Formula/vsp.rb
description: Implement ~/.config/vsp/config.jsonc composition (defaults.ux, defaults.ai, custom profiles with extends/with/without/overrides, exact-ID external extensions tagged user-unlocked in doctor; reject repo-local .vsp.toml and wildcard publisher trust), vsp init [--apply], vsp self {path,install,uninstall,update}, dynamic completions from live pack/preset graph, complete vspcli compatibility argument/exit-code mode so legacy callers work via Rust binary, and Formula/vsp.rb template ready for artagon/homebrew-aitools.
acceptance_criteria: Custom user profiles compose without repo fork and pass policy/autonomy gates; hostile cwd .vsp.toml is ignored; vsp self install/path works; Formula/vsp.rb syntax valid; cargo test/clippy/doc pass.

title: Phase 3.2 (v3.0.0): Thin vspcli shims, retire ported Bash libs/static completions & update all project docs
description: Convert scripts/vspcli and supported legacy wrappers into thin shims delegating to compiled vsp binary; delete drifted scripts/.vspcli-completion.{zsh,fish}, diverged setup-{rust,java,cpp}-toolchain.sh, and ported scripts/lib/*.sh (retaining packs/rtk-terminal/scripts/ and tests); update README.md, ABOUT.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/, and openspec/config.yaml to reflect vsp v3.0.0 single-CLI and packs/presets architecture.
acceptance_criteria: vspcli shim passes legacy BATS contracts via compiled vsp; zero dead doc flags; ShellCheck/Zsh/Fish clean on all remaining scripts.

title: Phase 1.2 (v2.1.0): Bootstrap crates/vsp Rust read-only planner, legacy reader, diff/detect/doctor & dev dist
description: Create Cargo workspace (Cargo.toml + crates/vsp) with clap, serde, serde_json, sha2, semver, clap_complete. Implement typed domain model, legacy-layout reader (catalog/, modules/, profiles/), DAG module resolver, nested-safe autonomy & scope policy validator, Plan(desired, observation, scope), and read-only CLI commands: list, show, detect (--explain), diff (--check), doctor (--strict), export, completions, dev validate, dev dist (15 canonical + 22 materialized legacy aliases + sorted SHA256SUMS). Use jsonc-parser CST for lossless comment-preserving settings merge (retiring --allow-comment-loss), Step 0 unconditional compromised uninstall before network, bounded 4-worker HTTPS/host-checked VSIX verifier with XDG cache, fs4 lock + CAS storage.json writer (skipping storage.json writes when profile already exists), XDG state provenance, and exit codes 0..7. Add unit, CST comment-preservation property tests, and offline mocked-code integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: vsp diff equals vsp sync --dry-run; CST tests prove 100% preservation of // and /* */ comments across repeated syncs and pack switches; Step 0 runs before network/install; exit codes 0..7 verified; cargo test/clippy/doc pass.
